entities.title: Engine
entities.summary: The game with no page and no clock: its numbers, its seeded generator, the burrow digger, the Game and a simple player for the demo.
entities.purpose: Plays Lundey one step (a sixtieth of a second) at a time from a seed and the player's controls, so the page and the tests get the same game from the same seed and the same controls.
boundaries: Positions, speeds and times are whole numbers (thousandths of a tile, and steps), and random numbers come only from rng.ts. Nothing here reads a clock, the page or the network.
Decides everything about the game and draws nothing: the page (src/main.ts) steps it, and src/ui/ draws it and sounds its events.
autopilot.ts is a player, not a rule: it reads a Game and answers a direction, for the title screen's demo and for the tests.
Nothing records or replays a game: the best score is the page's, kept on the device (games/lundey/.dev/backlog.json, replay-checked-table).
